crossRefs.note: Seth lived one hundred five years, then became the father of Enosh.

people.name: Enoch
people.line: A righteous man who walked with God.

people.name: Jared
people.line: Ancestor of Noah; father of Enoch

people.name: Kenan
people.line: Son of Enosh, descendant of Seth

people.name: Mahalalel
people.line: Descendant of Seth; ancestor of Noah

people.name: Methuselah
people.line: The oldest person mentioned in the Bible.

translations.web: the son of Methuselah, the son of Enoch, the son of Jared, the son of Mahalaleel, the son of Cainan,
